title: stainless steamer basket
text: stainless steamer basket. This is a lovely blend of silicone protectors and stainless steel basket.  It folds up easily and works exactly as you would hope.  I think you could wash in the dishwasher, but I have been hand washing.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Joseph Joseph - 45033 Joseph Joseph Bloom Stainless-Steel Steamer Basket Folding, One-Size
features: Extra-large capacity and suitable for use with both non-stick and stainless-steel pans
Self-adjusting design fits a variety of pan sizes – minimum 7 inches (18 cm)
Heat-resistant silicone feet and fins. Easy-lift fork hook – removable for steaming larger portions
Dimensions: H3.9 x W6.3 x D6.3 inches (H10 x W16 x D16 cm)
Folds for compact storage. Dishwasher safe.
description: This large folding steamer basket is made from durable stainless-steel and has self-adjusting sides, heat-resistant silicone feet and silicone side fins. It features an easy-lift handle for safe removal, has an extra-large capacity when fully open and folds neatly away for compact storage. Fits a variety of pan sizes – minimum 7 inches (18 cm). It’s ideal for use with both non-stick and stainless-steel pans. Dishwasher safe. Dimensions: H3.9 x W6.3 x D6.3 inches (H10 x W16 x D16 cm).
